versions.content: If the function PduR_LinTpStartOfReception returns BUFREQ_OK with a smaller available buffer size than needed for the data received in the first frame of a TP message (SF or FF), the LIN Interface shall abort the reception and notify the upper layer by calling the function PduR_LinTpRxIndication with result E_NOT_OK.
